case.scope: Fleet SPIDER delivery and provider-supported lunar surface operations on the far side; no general entitlement for other payloads, sites or actors

sources.assertion: Firefly announced an agreement with Australian Fleet Space to deliver and operate SPIDER on Blue Ghost Mission 2; the lander would provide power and communications.
The Blue Ghost Mission 2 presentation reports that Fleet SPIDER had been delivered to Firefly for integration; the mission remained pre-launch.

limitations: Agreement is for Fleet SPIDER, not the Australian state or an arbitrary lunar payload
Announcement does not establish a completed lunar delivery or a reserved slot for CIVPROP-0
No synthetic polar-site service, payload envelope, five-day transfer, exact launch date or price is established
